Working on this date

Model basis and assumptions
  • Activities: Annex 3 Detailed Bar Chart, Baseline V0.4 (WBS CO.2.1, CO.2.2, CO.2.3, CO.2.5 and PW.3.1/3.2). Each concrete activity with an EL range is one lift; grouting, gate slots, anchors and crest works are shown as "other works" on their block.
  • Block positions from PL-HNT-28…39: RB non-overflow blocks ㉗–㊱ at RB 0+376–0+574.5 (schedule Block #1 = ㉗); navigation lock 0+334–0+376; shallow-crest spillway 0+214–0+334 (sections 10–15); deep-crest spillway 0+045.5–0+214 (sections 1–9); bottom outlet LB 0+008–RB 0+045.5.
  • Cross-sections are simplified gravity profiles (crest EL 245). Modelled volumes are for progress weighting only, not BOQ. The RB non-overflow model is about 21% above the drawing total of 44,682 m³.
  • Assumed where the drawings and schedule don't say: order of spillway sections (1 next to bottom outlet), bottom outlet Block #1 on the spillway side, weir crests at EL 222/230, lock chamber clear width 18 m, and the layout of approach walls and berthing piles. Lock layout per PL-HNT-30: upper head 0+000–0+036, chamber to 0+140, lower head to 0+170, outlet to 0+190.
    • \n
  • 1st-stage transverse cofferdams from drawings PL_PO_PCL_++UTC (Rev 01): upstream crest EL 236.5 (A0-002.934–A0+515.532), downstream crest EL 234.5 (B0-005–B0+418.170). Both have compacted rockfill outer shells and a soil (clay) core with 1 m filter and transition layers each side, 8 m crests, 1:2.0 river-side and 1:1.8 pit-side slopes, and foundation levels from the longitudinal profiles. They are placed 380 m apart (from the control-point coordinates) at Dam 0-132.5 and 0+247.5, matching the cofferdam-occupied sections of the lock approach channels, and both end on the longitudinal cofferdam axis. Backfilling and dismantling follow Baseline V0.4 (PW.3.2.3 / PW.3.2.4).
    • \n
  • River closure follows Baseline V0.4 PW.3.5. The pre-closure advance filling (01–17 Dec 2028) is a rockfill pre-cofferdam advanced from the left bank across the left channel, just upstream of the Stage 1 longitudinal cofferdam tip, to about 70% of the channel. River closure (18–30 Dec 2028) seals the last gap at the cofferdam tip. Dyke crest EL 228, 10 m wide, 1:1.5 slopes; position, left bank and dyke size are indicative, not to drawing. After closure the river is shown passing through the deep spillway (crest EL 222, gates raised) and the bottom outlet. Indicative water levels are upstream EL 221 rising to 225.5 during closure and tailwater EL 216, so the shallow spillway (crest EL 230) stays dry. The Stage 1 area stays dry until river closure is complete (30 Dec 2028); only then is water diverted into it. In the left river reach downstream of the closure dyke, the water drops during closure. After 30 Dec 2028 that reach shows as a dry riverbed (about EL 207) with a few shallow pools.
    • \n
  • Longitudinal cofferdams are traced from Figure 1-1 (Layout Plan of the 1st river diversion), scaled from the transverse cofferdams. Stage 1 follows its dog-leg line for 511 m (V0.4: CH 0+000–0+502) in 20 blocks, lifts EL 217/218–238. Stage 2 (purple in the figure, V0.4 PW.3.6.2, 8 blocks, 22-Jun-27 to 16-Mar-28) has the same lift heights and widths along its traced line, about 266 m. Its line is shifted about 6 m towards the river to keep clear of the bottom outlet, within the figure's accuracy of about ±5 m. Blocks are numbered from the upstream end. The width of each lift is 6 m + 0.5 × (238 − lift EL).
    • \n
  • Stage 1 longitudinal cofferdam blocks 7–16 are demolished from 03-May-29 to 30-Jun-29, per site instruction (replacing V0.4 PLHPP-PW-1L-11710). The order runs from the centre outwards: 11 & 12, 10 & 13, 9 & 14, 8 & 15, then 7 & 16, about 12 days per pair. Each block comes down from its top lift.
  • Spillway guide walls (PL-HNT-35 middle guide wall at RB 0+214, 3 sections; PL-HNT-36 deep spillway guide wall at RB 0+045.5, 7 sections; EL 202/203–235) use dates from the updated P6 schedule (PLHPP-15.CO.8.2/8.3). That print has no total float column, so they show as n/a in float mode. Section lengths (~14 m) are scaled from the drawings.
  • Right bank abutment is shown as completed and shaped from the site photo: a lower rock face, two frame-beam faces and two shotcrete faces with 3 m berms (berms assumed at EL 250, 265, 280, 295, top about EL 310). Slopes of 1:0.5–1:0.75 are estimated from the photo, not taken from drawings.
    • \n
  • Road 1 runs upstream–downstream at EL 245 on a bench at the toe of the right abutment, next to the end of the non-overflow dam crest. The 7 m carriageway is from the site plan road edge lines. The alignment follows your description: the site plan's coordinates don't match the cofferdam drawings, so I couldn't overlay it. Where natural ground is lower it sits on fill, and end ramps aren't modelled. Baseline V0.4 Road 1# subbase finishes 22-Oct-26, so it shows as a crushed-stone road for the whole Phase 1 period; concrete pavement is Jun-2032.
  • Dam crest per PL-HNT-28: crest EL 245.0, 15 m wide (Dam 0-008–0+007), with a 3 m upstream overhang on a 1:1 bracket from EL 240.5. The downstream face is vertical to EL 229.5, then 1:0.75, with a parapet on the upstream edge. With the exact profile the RB non-overflow model is about 28% above the drawing total, because of the assumed rock stepping inside each block.
    • \n
  • Crest structures and metal structure installation follow Baseline V0.4 (CO.2.3.16, CO.2.5.6, CO.6.1–6.3). Spillway top beams are on bays 1#–14# between the piers, with bridge paving, gantry crane track, wave-breaking wall and cable trench. Deep spillway service gates and hoists 1#–8# are on bays 1–8 and shallow 1#–6# on bays 9–14, plus bulkhead gates, a two-way gantry crane, the bottom outlet hoist frame (to EL 256 and then the top), cranes and gates, and the lock head gates, hoists and movable bridge. Gates are drawn as plane panels in their bays; sizes and positions are indicative. Other items (gate slots, fish passage, mooring rings, overhead cranes) are listed as activities without geometry.
    • \n
  • Stilling basin and apron follow Baseline V0.4. Base slab Z1–Z7 is the deep spillway stilling basin (PL-HNT-33): sections Ⅰ–Ⅵ from Dam 0+046 to 0+134 at EL 203–206, then section Ⅶ, the end sill rising to EL 212, with the apron to 0+169 included in Z7. Apron Z1–Z12 is the shallow spillway apron (PL-HNT-32): section Ⅰ (20 m) and Ⅱ (25 m, with an end cutoff to EL 210) at EL 216–218, one zone per bay; this zone-to-bay mapping is my reading. The bottom outlet's downstream dissipation structure is its zone III.
    • \n
  • Excavation and grouting adits are not modelled.
